data.title: Residential Proxy Login Attempt
data.description: Detects login attempts originating from known residential proxy networks. Credential stuffing actors increasingly route attacks through residential proxies (Luminati/Bright Data, Oxylabs, SmartProxy) to appear as legitimate home users and bypass IP-reputation blocklists. This rule correlates source IPs against residential proxy threat intelligence feeds.
falsepositives: Legitimate users whose ISP IP ranges overlap with residential proxy exit nodes
Privacy-conscious users routing through VPN services that share residential IP pools
